selector.champion: Saturday night retinopathy with orbital compression syndrome
selector.rationale: Vision loss, pain, numbness, and erythematous induration of the right eyelids, along with tense eyelid edema and relative afferent pupillary defect, are best explained by Saturday night retinopathy with orbital compression syndrome

rejected.label: Acute Angle-Closure Glaucoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for angle closure

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: Presence of serous retinal detachment and macular whitening, but not typical of central retinal artery occlusion

rejected.label: Rhabdomyolysis
rejected.why: Elevated creatine kinase level, but not directly related to vision loss

rejected.label: Toxic optic neuropathy
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for toxic optic neuropathy, despite buprenorphine/naloxone use
